389:t_1:86.en:
$$アムロ$$
「There are certainly times when we just don't understand the younger generation.」

389:t_1:87.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$カミーユ$$, $$シン$$, $$キラ$$, $$バナージ$$, $$クェス$$, $$カツ$$, $$ハサウェイ$$, $$ガロード$$, $$ヒイロ$$, $$五飛$$... They are beyond my understanding.」

389:t_1:88.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We agree for once, $$シャア$$.」

389:t_1:89.en:
$$シャア$$
「It means you've reached a position where simply being a pilot is no longer enough.」

389:t_1:90.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ブライト$$ was concerned too. He hopes you'll grow up in your personal life soon.」

389:t_1:91.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I wish the old man would give me a break.」

389:t_1:92.en:
$$ランド$$
(How long is this pointless rambling gonna go on...?)

389:t_1:93.en:
$$ランド$$
(Is old-man power being able to do this without even drinking...?)

389:t_1:94.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Isn't this turning into an old guys' gripe session?」

389:t_1:95.en:
$$マリ$$
「Why don't you join in? I think it's a good chance to vent all your pent-up frustration, nya~.」

389:t_1:96.en:
$$チコ$$
「Frustration? So you've been bottling it up...」

389:t_1:97.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I-I'm fine! You don't need to worry!」

389:t_1:100.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$アスカ$$... I heard about you before we joined up... That our personalities overlap a little.」

389:t_1:101.en:
$$チコ$$
「But when I actually met you, you were different... You're more mature than I thought.」

389:t_1:104.en:
$$マリ$$
「That self-mocking tone... You refuse to grow up, don't you?」

389:t_1:106.en:
$$マリ$$
「But you can't stay a boy forever... That gap is going to hurt you.」

389:t_1:107.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I don't much care for people making assumptions about me.」

389:t_1:108.en:
$$マリ$$
「Remember this, $$ニコラ$$. Deep down, real boys are always wishing they could grow up.」

389:t_1:109.en:
$$マリ$$
「Being a boy doesn't mean rejecting adulthood... It means being on your way there.」

389:t_1:111.en:
$$チコ$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Don't tell me you're...」

389:t_1:112.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Now, $$チコ$$. Don't go telling the Princess anything she doesn't need to hear.」

389:t_1:113.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「For the record, 《$$あがり$$》 is still a long way off for me.」

389:t_1:115.en:
$$マリ$$
(They've all got their own hang-ups...)

389:t_1:116.en:
$$ランド$$
(It's been an hour already... What part of this is training, $$クロウ$$...?)

389:t_1:117.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are you listening, $$ランド・トラビス$$!?」

389:t_1:119.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「For starters, in battle you charge headlong, or rather, you don't see what's happening around you...」

389:t_1:120.en:
$$大杉$$
「That is part of $$ランド$$'s appeal, but the problem is that he takes it a little too far.」

389:t_1:121.en:
$$イアン$$
「It's fine to make repairs on the battlefield, but sometimes you're far too rough about it.」

389:t_1:122.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Indeed. There's more to a machine than just getting it to run.」

389:t_1:123.en:
$$ランド$$
(This... is starting to look worse and worse for me...)

389:t_1:127.en:
$$ランド$$
(It's been a long time since I remembered the Boss teaching me the basics of repairs when I was a kid.)

389:t_1:129.en:
$$隼人$$
「This training is meant to stress your mind and body, but physical pain should produce quicker results.」

389:t_1:131.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Don't hold it against us, $$ランド$$!」

389:t_1:132.en:
$$隼人$$
「We're doing this for your sake too.」

389:t_1:133.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait! The Boss used to say that kind of thing to me all the time!」

389:t_1:134.en:
$$オットー$$
「I don't want to hear excuses! Consider this part of your instruction!」

389:t_1:135.en:
$$ミヒロ$$
「A fleet believed to belong to $$サイデリアル$$ is approaching. Captain $$オットー$$, report to the bridge immediately.」

389:t_1:136.en:
$$オットー$$
「You heard her! Everyone, to your stations!」

389:t_1:138.en:
$$シャア$$
「A $$サイデリアル$$ fleet... Then...」

389:t_1:139.en:
$$ランド$$
「Yeah, I can feel it...! That bastard $$ストラウス$$ is coming!」

389:t_2:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「It sounds like a lot happened in the $$残されの海$$ too.」

389:t_2:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「Did you get even more tanned, $$レド$$?」

389:t_2:7.en:
$$レド$$
「I got to spend a few days with the fleet.」

389:t_2:8.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「A few days...? But we were apart for about a month!」

389:t_2:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Actually... I split off from $$アルト$$ and the others too. I was somewhere away from the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

389:t_2:10.en:
$$勝平$$
「What were you doing, Big Bro $$レド$$?」

389:t_2:12.en:
$$レド$$
「...The $$クジライカ$$ were $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ that had adapted to Earth's environment.」

389:t_2:14.en:
$$マオ$$
「I heard before that the fleet's people worship those $$クジライカ$$ as emissaries of God, don't they...?」

389:t_2:15.en:
$$レド$$
「That's why $$エイミー$$ and the people of the fleet opposed my attacking the $$クジライカ$$.」

389:t_2:16.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「So $$レド$$ and I left $c and headed for their nest.」

389:t_2:17.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Why did you get involved, $$ピニオン$$?」

389:t_2:18.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Their nest held treasure... Relics left behind by a civilization that had died out.」

389:t_2:19.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「$$レド$$ would kill the $$クジライカ$$, and I'd salvage the treasure. Our interests lined up.」

389:t_2:20.en:
$$レド$$
(That's where I learned what the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ really were...)

389:t_2:21.en:
$$レド$$
(But I don't intend to tell anyone... If the need ever arises, I can reveal it then...)

389:t_2:22.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「And the surprises just kept coming. An old acquaintance of $$レド$$'s actually showed up.」

389:t_2:23.en:
$$宗介$$
「An acquaintance of $$レド$$'s... So that means someone from the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

389:t_2:24.en:
$$レド$$
「Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ was my superior officer.」

389:t_2:25.en:
$$レド$$
「He was trying to use force to build a social system on this $$翠の地球$$ like the one in the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

389:t_2:26.en:
$$甲児$$
「You mean... he was trying to rule over people?」

389:t_2:27.en:
$$レド$$
「Exactly. ...But apparently, before he could fulfill that ambition, Lieutenant Colonel $$クーゲル$$ contracted a local disease and died.」

389:t_2:28.en:
$$勝平$$
「Hold on! Then your story doesn't add up!」
